observations.accessibilityTree:
- link "Skip to main content":
  - /url: "#public-content"
- banner "One Talibon. One workspace.":
  - img "Talibon Municipal Hall, front entrance with Philippine flags"
  - link "ONE TALIBON home":
    - /url: "#home"
    - text: ONE TALIBON
  - link "Employee Login":
    - /url: /login
  - button "Open portal navigation"
  - paragraph: LGU INTRA-OFFICE PORTAL
  - heading "One Talibon. One workspace." [level=1]
  - paragraph: Municipal work, connected across offices. Manage documents, memoranda, schedules, projects, requests, and office coordination in one secure workspace.
  - link "Employee Login":
    - /url: /login
  - link "About the Portal":
    - /url: "#about-portal"
  - paragraph: Authorized municipal personnel only. Protected operational records remain inside authenticated access.
- main:
  - region "Portal Capabilities":
    - paragraph: Internal portal capabilities
    - heading "Portal Capabilities" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Core tools for moving municipal work between offices.
    - text: Available to authorized employees
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - heading "Inter-Office Transactions" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Route requests, endorsements, and actions between offices.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Documents & Memoranda" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Manage official documents, memoranda, records, and correspondence.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Employees & Offices" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Find office and personnel information in one workspace.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Calendar & Coordination" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Coordinate meetings, deadlines, activities, and schedules.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Notifications & Follow-Up" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Track work that needs review, action, or follow-up.
  - region "Built for municipal coordination.":
    - img "Municipality of Talibon seal"
    - paragraph: About the Portal
    - heading "Built for municipal coordination." [level=2]
    - paragraph: ONE TALIBON is the LGU’s shared intra-office workspace for coordinating official work, information, documents, schedules, and processes across municipal offices.
    - paragraph: Municipality of Talibon, Bohol
    - term: Access boundary
    - definition: Internal records, transactions, approvals, and employee information require authenticated access.
    - term: Municipality of Talibon
    - definition: Public contact details await municipal confirmation.
  - region "Secure municipal workspace.":
    - paragraph: Secure Access
    - heading "Secure municipal workspace." [level=2]
    - paragraph: Official work continues inside the authenticated LGU Intra-Office Portal.
    - list:
      - listitem: Authorized personnel only
      - listitem: Protected internal workspace
      - listitem: No live operational records on this page
    - link "Employee Login":
      - /url: /login
- contentinfo:
  - link "ONE TALIBON":
    - /url: "#home"
  - text: Municipality of Talibon, Bohol Talibon, Bohol, Philippines
  - navigation "Footer":
    - link "About the Portal":
      - /url: "#about-portal"
    - link "Internal Capabilities":
      - /url: "#capabilities"
    - link "Help / Support":
      - /url: "#support"
  - text: ONE TALIBON · Municipality of Talibon, Bohol Intra-Office Portal · Authorized municipal personnel

  - heading "Councils, Boards & Committees" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Reference directory for the municipality's formal local special bodies, with mandate, chair role, membership context, scheduled meeting, recent action, and related records.

  - text: Search councils, boards, and committees

  - region "Councils, boards & committees register":
    - heading "Councils, boards & committees register" [level=2]
    - text: 12 bodies
    - article:
      - text: LSB-01
      - heading "Municipal Development Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates municipal development planning, investment priorities, and sector participation.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Executive offices, barangay representatives, Sangguniang Bayan representation, and accredited sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-24 · Development investment programming session
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Comprehensive Development Plan · Local Development Investment Program · Annual Investment Program
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed sector submissions for the annual investment program
    - article:
      - text: LSB-02
      - heading "Local School Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor / Schools Division representative"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local support for public basic education and use of the Special Education Fund.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Municipal executive, education representatives, council representation, parent and teacher sectors
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-10-02 · Special Education Fund program review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local School Board resolutions · Special Education Fund work program
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed current school facility and learning-support priorities
    - article:
      - text: LSB-03
      - heading "Local Health Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local health policy, program priorities, facility concerns, and health-system support.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Municipal Health Officer, health sector representatives, council representation, and partner institutions
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-29 · Health program implementation review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local Health Investment Plan · Health Board resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed health facility readiness and priority public health activities
    - article:
      - text: LSB-04
      - heading "Municipal Peace and Order Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local peace and order planning, inter-agency concerns, and community safety priorities.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Local executive, police, fire, interior and local government, council, and sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-22 · Peace and order situation review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Peace and Order and Public Safety Plan · Council resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Consolidated current barangay and inter-agency coordination items
    - article:
      - text: LSB-05
      - heading "Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery priorities.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Municipal offices, response agencies, utilities, civil society, and sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-18 · Preparedness and response readiness review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local DRRM Plan · Contingency plans · LDRRM Fund investment plan
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed response assets, prepositioning, and barangay readiness
    - article:
      - text: LSB-06
      - heading "Local Council for the Protection of Children" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates child protection policy, prevention, referral, program monitoring, and local council actions.

      - definition: Social welfare, health, education, police, council, youth, and child-protection stakeholders

      - definition: 2026-10-06 · Child protection program review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local Plan of Action for Children · LCPC resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed prevention activities and referral coordination
    - article:
      - text: LSB-07
      - heading "Municipal Solid Waste Management Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates ecological solid waste management planning, compliance, diversion, and facility concerns.
